claim: New general text from the sheet.

suggestion.to: PROSPECT is the European Space Agency's exploration science payload for finding and analysing water ice and other materials on the Moon. An Italian drill collects samples from up to a metre below the surface, for analysis in the OU-provided ProSPA instrument. The package will be delivered to a south polar region of the Moon by the Intuitive Machines IM-4 lander in 2028.
